Air-Gap Data Exchange

Securely transfer data between air-gapped environments using encrypted data packages.

airgap

API router for the offline cross-domain data exchange (airgap) module.

This module exposes the endpoints for exporting and importing .defpack bundles between air-gapped systems. These endpoints enable secure data transfer between sovereign networks that share no live connectivity — for example, from an unclassified development environment to a classified operational environment.

Endpoints

POST /api/v1/airgap/export

Generate a signed and encrypted .defpack bundle for a project sub-tree. Nodes classified above the target ceiling are redacted. The bundle is streamed as a file download.

POST /api/v1/airgap/import

Ingest an uploaded .defpack file into the target air-gapped PostgreSQL instance. Performs signature verification, schema validation, replay attack detection, and ltree reparenting. Returns an import validation report.

Sub-Tree Locking

The POST /import endpoint acquires a sub-tree lock before merging imported nodes into the target database. This prevents concurrent mutations from interfering with the ltree reparenting process. If a lock is already held, HTTP 423 (Locked) is returned.

Security Considerations

  • Both endpoints require a valid JWT token via the get_current_user dependency.

  • The export endpoint enforces that the user’s clearance meets or exceeds the requested classification ceiling.

  • The import endpoint verifies the package signature, validates the JSON schema, checks for duplicate transaction IDs (replay attack prevention), and verifies the importer’s clearance.

  • Every export and import is logged in the ForensicAuditLog with the user’s identity and the classification marking.

Usage

# Export a .defpack bundle: POST /api/v1/airgap/export { “project_id”: “uuid…”, “classification_ceiling”: “SECRET” }

# Import an uploaded .defpack bundle: POST /api/v1/airgap/import (multipart form with .defpack file and optional parent_node_id)
